sloka: यथागमं च यो राजा समयं विचिकीर्षति ।बुध्यते सचिवान् बुद्ध्या सुहृदश्चानुपश्यति ।। ६.६३.८ ।।
transliteration: yathāgamaṁ ca yo rājā samayaṁ vicikīrṣati ।budhyate sacivān buddhyā suhṛdaścānupaśyati ।। 6.63.8 ।।

translations.english: "The king who does his duty in time in accordance with justice and thinking intelligently with his ministers, understands rightly."
